name: overview-two-sided-plates.jpg
subject: both plates of a two-sided puller
shows: the two identical printed plates lying side by side, toothed arms up, before assembly
alt: The two printed plates of a two-sided puller lying side by side on a cutting mat, their toothed arms pointing up.
caption: Both plates are the same part: one is turned over in the next steps so their teeth face each other.

name: part-plates-and-standard-plug.jpg
subject: the plates and a standard 3-prong plug
shows: the two plates with a black standard 3-prong plug between them
alt: The two plates of a two-sided puller with a black 3-prong plug and its cord laid between them.
caption: The parts for one puller: two plates, the plug the tool was made for, and three zip ties (not shown).

name: stage-plug-between-plates.jpg
subject: the plates and the heavy-duty plug
shows: the two plates with the orange heavy-duty extension-cord plug laid between them
alt: The two plates of a two-sided puller with an orange heavy-duty extension-cord plug laid between them.
caption: The heavy-duty extension-cord plug between the two plates made for it.

name: stage-plug-on-first-plate.jpg
subject: the plug laid on the first plate
shows: the plug lying between the arms of the first plate, prongs toward the arm tips, cord through the channel
alt: The orange plug lying on the first plate, between its two toothed arms, prongs past the arm tips and the cord running out between the finger holes; the second plate waits beside it.
caption: The plug lies between the arms of the first plate, its prongs toward the arm tips and its cord in the channel between the finger holes.

name: stage-second-plate-on.jpg
subject: the second plate laid over the plug
shows: the second plate turned over and laid on top, the plug sandwiched between the two plates
alt: The plug sandwiched between the two plates, the second plate laid on top so its outline matches the first.
caption: The second plate is turned over and laid on top, its outline over the first plate's and its teeth on the plug.

name: stage-zip-ties-threaded.jpg
subject: zip ties threaded through both plates
shows: three zip ties threaded through the matching holes of both plates, tails loose
alt: Three black zip ties threaded down through the holes on one side of both plates, their long tails loose to the right.
caption: Each tie goes down through a hole of the top plate and the matching hole of the plate under it.

name: stage-zip-ties-pulled.jpg
subject: zip ties pulled tight
shows: the three zip ties pulled snug around the plates, tails still uncut
alt: The three zip ties pulled snug around both plates and the plug, their tails not yet cut.
caption: The ties are pulled tight, a little at a time on each, until the plug no longer moves between the plates.

name: finished-two-sided-heavy-duty-plug.jpg
subject: the finished puller on the heavy-duty plug
shows: the finished two-sided puller zip-tied on the orange heavy-duty plug: a tie near the prongs, one behind the plug body, one around the cord
alt: The finished two-sided puller zip-tied around the orange heavy-duty extension-cord plug: one tie near the prongs, one behind the plug body and one around the cord between the finger holes.
caption: The finished puller stays on the plug, the finger holes free; the tie tails are trimmed.

name: finished-two-sided-standard-plug.jpg
subject: the finished puller on the standard plug
shows: the finished two-sided puller zip-tied on a black standard 3-prong plug
alt: The finished two-sided puller zip-tied around a black standard 3-prong plug, seen from above.
caption: The same tool made for the standard 3-prong plug preset.

name: stage-pull-standard-plug.jpg
subject: pulling a standard plug from a power strip
shows: a gloved hand with two fingers through the finger holes, pulling the standard plug straight out of a yellow power strip
alt: A gloved hand with two fingers through the finger holes of a two-sided puller, pulling a black 3-prong plug straight out of a yellow power strip.
caption: Two fingers through the finger holes, and a straight pull away from the outlet.

name: stage-pull-heavy-duty-plug.jpg
subject: pulling the heavy-duty plug from a power strip
shows: a gloved hand holding the two-sided puller by its finger holes, the orange plug in the power strip
alt: A gloved hand holding a two-sided puller by its finger holes, the orange heavy-duty plug still in the yellow power strip.
caption: The heavy-duty plug just before the pull: the fingers are in the holes and the tool is square to the outlet.

name: stage-pull-heavy-duty-plug-side.jpg
subject: the pull seen from the side
shows: the two-sided puller on the orange plug seen from the side as the hand pulls it from the power strip
alt: The two-sided puller on the orange plug seen from the side, a gloved hand pulling it straight back from the power strip.
caption: From the side: the two plates hold the plug's sides, and nothing goes between the plug and the outlet.

name: finished-one-sided-lamp-plug-small.jpg
subject: the one-sided puller at Small on a lamp plug
shows: the one-sided puller at Small size strapped to a black 2-prong lamp plug, a printed hand model beside it
alt: The one-sided puller at Small size strapped to a black 2-prong lamp plug, on the printer bed beside a printed hand model for scale.
caption: The one-sided puller at Small size on a 2-prong lamp plug.

name: finished-one-sided-lamp-plug-medium.jpg
subject: the one-sided puller at Medium on a lamp plug
shows: the one-sided puller at Medium size strapped to a black 2-prong lamp plug, a printed hand model beside it
alt: The one-sided puller at Medium size strapped to a black 2-prong lamp plug, beside a printed hand model for scale.
caption: The one-sided puller at Medium size: the plug lies in the pocket, the strap goes through the two wing openings, and the cord sits in the hook.

name: finished-one-sided-lamp-plug-large.jpg
subject: the one-sided puller at Large on a lamp plug
shows: the one-sided puller at Large size strapped to a black 2-prong lamp plug, a printed hand model beside it
alt: The one-sided puller at Large size strapped to a black 2-prong lamp plug, beside a printed hand model for scale.
caption: The one-sided puller at Large size on the same plug.

name: screen-browser-first-visit.png
subject: the Forge's first-visit window
shows: Assistive Forge chosen and Download & Continue
alt: The Assistive Forge's first-visit window with two red numbered boxes: 1 around the Assistive Forge choice, 2 around the Download & Continue button.

name: screen-browser-save-copy.png
subject: the shared-project window
shows: the Save My Copy button
alt: The Shared Project window naming Plug Puller, one-sided puller, with red box 1 around the Save My Copy button.

name: screen-browser-step-1-preset.png
subject: Step 1 with a preset picked
shows: the plug preset list and the Preview ready badge
alt: The customizer with Step 1 open: red box 1 around the plug preset list, set to Flat 2-prong lamp plug - NEMA 1-15, and red box 2 around the Preview ready badge over the preview of the tool with a see-through plug in its pocket.

name: screen-browser-generate.png
subject: the Generate button
shows: the Generate button below the preview
alt: The customizer with the lamp plug preset picked, red box 1 around the Generate button below the preview.

name: screen-browser-download.png
subject: the Download button
shows: the Download button after Generate
alt: The customizer after Generate: the preview shows the finished tool and red box 1 surrounds the Download button below it.
